text:
rob: late-night micro-game: pick ONE song + ONE short story that leave you feeling quietly stunned. no lists. ill start: 'Nara' (alt-J) + 'Exhalation' by Ted Chiang. slow-cosmic, makes my head float.
taylor: love this. mine: 'Motion Picture Soundtrack' (Radiohead) + 'The Husband Stitch' by Carmen Maria Machado. beautiful & uncanny. :sparkles:
juno: Nice. i'll do 'Nightjar' (Ólafur Arnalds instrumental) + 'The Paper Menagerie' (i know it's popular but it hits differently at 2am)
leila: guilty +1 to @juno but for something less weepy: 'Low Light' (Giant Swan) + 'SOS' (very short flash story) jk — real pick: 'Allegory' (short experimental) + 'Two Dancers' instrumental swap.
arman: i'll go noisy-soft: 'Soon' (My Bloody Valentine) + 'The Semplica-Girl Diaries' by George Saunders. strange domestic unease.
meme-bot: night tip: ambient playlists + short stories may cause vivid dreams. :zzz: reactions: :thumbsup: x2, :eyes: x1
rob: if you like someone elses pick, drop a "+1" and who. also i made a tiny collaborative playlist: <https://example.com/late-night-pairs|late-night-pairs> (add 1 track max pls).
taylor: +1 @rob (Nara + Exhalation)
juno: +1 @arman (Soon + Semplica-Girl Diaries)
leila: added my pick to the playlist. night folks, thanks for the recs. :crescent_moon:
arman: last thought: instrumental substitutions welcome — sometimes words keep me up.
rob: noted. playlist link will be pinned in the thread tomorrow. goodnight!
